subject: Freedom of Information request - fire at the Glamorgan-Gwent Archaeological Trust's warehouse, March 1983
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Freedom of Information Officer,

I am writing to request information under the Freedom of Information Act 2000.

The South Wales Echo of 18 March 1983 reported a warehouse fire that destroyed archaeological finds held by the Glamorgan-Gwent Archaeological Trust. I understand the fire was in the area then covered by the West Glamorgan fire service (reported as Swansea; one later account gives Neath), and that the Service, formed in April 1996 from the earlier Dyfed, Powys and West Glamorgan brigades, may now hold some of that area's records. I am trying to establish whether material from earlier excavations at Llandough-juxta-Penarth, including the site of Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr / Cydfin Farm, was among the finds affected.

Please provide:

1. any incident record, fire report or fire investigation report held for a fire at premises used by the Glamorgan-Gwent Archaeological Trust in or around March 1983, showing the date and time, the address, the cause recorded and the extent of the damage;

2. if no such record is now held, the retention or disposal schedule under which West Glamorgan fire service incident records of 1983 were kept or destroyed, any record of their destruction, and whether any of those records were transferred to an archive (and, if so, which).

Personal data of third parties may be redacted. I am happy to receive the information by email.

I would welcome a short acknowledgement.

Kind regards,

Requester 
Royal Signals Cyber/ Electronic Warfare Professional
bucklerfamily.estate
